sources.title: Embolotherium, gen. nov., of the Ulan Gochu, Mongolia: AMNH 26001 type skull plate

sources.supports: Type-specimen identity; side, anterior and dorsal/oblique morphology of broad ram, nasal channel, eye region and deep skull.

sources.title: Mick Ellison AMNH portfolio: Embolotherium andrewsi
